verdicts.reason: A breaks the design: the headline has shrunk to tiny text pulled out of the frame and placed on the busy knuckles, so it is barely readable. The bracket frame is left empty over the hands, and the accent dash is stranded alone near the bottom edge. B keeps the headline large, roughly inside the frame and on darker ground, but it collides badly: the frame's bottom rule slices through the descenders of 'Level', 'Next' runs into the right bracket, and the dash is jammed against the frame line. It still needs a real fix, but it is clearly the less broken resize.
